description: Backend: add GET /api/pathology/trends/ endpoint + POST /api/predictions/simulate/ endpoint + POST /api/ai/explain/ endpoint + EmergencyToken model with generate/revoke/public-read views. Frontend: Theme system (ThemeContext + CSS variables + navbar toggle). These backend+CSS/context pieces have no frontend UI dependencies on each other and are the foundation for all other FEATs.
steps: 1. In backend/medical/models.py, add EmergencyToken model after PredictionRecord: `patient = OneToOneField(Patient, CASCADE, related_name='emergency_token')`, `token = CharField(max_length=64, unique=True)`, `created_at = DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)`, `expires_at = DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)`, `is_active = BooleanField(default=True)`. No other model changes needed.
2. Run: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations — this produces migration 0006_emergencytoken.py.

4. In backend/medical/services/ai_service.py, change _predict_using_ml return type from Optional[float] to Optional[dict]. At the end of each disease branch, instead of `return round(score, 1)`, return `{'score': round(score, 1), 'factors': factors_list}` where factors_list is built by zipping feature names with model.feature_importances_, sorting by importance descending, taking top 5, and each entry is `{'feature': name, 'importance': float(imp), 'value': actual_param_value}`. Feature name arrays are defined as constants at the top of each branch:
  - Heart: ['Age','Gender','Systolic BP','Diastolic BP','Cholesterol','Max Heart Rate','Chest Pain','Exercise Angina','Fasting Sugar','Shortness of Breath','Left Arm Pain']
  - Diabetes: ['Age','Gender','Glucose','HbA1c','BMI','Hypertension','Heart Disease','Family History','Excessive Thirst','Frequent Urination','Blurry Vision','Slow Healing Sores']
  - Cancer: ['Age','Gender','Family History','Smoking','Alcohol','Toxin Exposure','Weight Loss','Persistent Cough','Fatigue','Skin/Mole Changes','Unusual Lumps']
  The `features` numpy array already has values in matching order; extract them with `features[0].tolist()` before the model.predict call to pair with names. Add `model.feature_importances_` extraction after `model = pickle.load(...)`. Wrap entire block in try/except — on exception return None as before.

5. In backend/medical/services/ai_service.py, update _get_fallback_prediction to handle new dict return from _predict_using_ml: change `ml_score = self._predict_using_ml(...)` to capture both score and factors. If ml_score is not None, extract `risk_score = ml_result['score']` and `ml_factors = ml_result['factors']`, else factors=[]. Add `'factors': ml_factors` to the returned dict from _get_fallback_prediction.

6. In backend/medical/services/ai_service.py, update predict_health_risk: after parsing res from _parse_json, if 'factors' key missing (Gemini path), set `res['factors'] = []`. After _get_fallback_prediction call, factors already present. Return value is unchanged shape.

7. In backend/medical/views.py, update run_prediction view: after `analysis = run_async(...)`, extract `factors = analysis.get('factors', [])`. In all three return paths (patient/guest/anon), add `'factors': factors` to the JsonResponse dict. Do NOT add factors to PredictionRecord.to_dict() — factors are ephemeral, not stored.

12. In backend/medical/urls.py, add new URL patterns:
```python
# Pathology trends
re_path(r'^pathology/trends/?$', views.pathology_trends, name='pathology_trends'),
# Prediction simulate
re_path(r'^predictions/simulate/?$', views.simulate_prediction, name='simulate_prediction'),
# AI explain
re_path(r'^ai/explain/?$', views.explain_result, name='explain_result'),
# Emergency token endpoints
re_path(r'^emergency/generate/?$', views.generate_emergency_token, name='generate_emergency_token'),
re_path(r'^emergency/revoke/?$', views.revoke_emergency_token, name='revoke_emergency_token'),
re_path(r'^emergency/(?P<token>[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/?$', views.get_emergency_card, name='get_emergency_card'),
```
IMPORTANT: Place pathology/trends BEFORE the existing `pathology/?$` pattern to avoid regex shadowing.

15. In frontend/src/App.jsx: (a) Import ThemeProvider from './context/ThemeContext' and wrap the entire <Router> in <ThemeProvider>. (b) In the Navbar function, import { Sun, Moon } from 'lucide-react' (add to existing lucide import line) and import { useTheme } from './context/ThemeContext'. Add a theme toggle button in the desktop nav next to the existing Login/profile items: `<button onClick={toggleTheme} className='btn-icon p-2 border-0 bg-transparent text-white' title='Toggle theme'>{theme === 'dark' ? <Sun size={20} /> : <Moon size={20} />}</button>`. Use `const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();` inside Navbar.
